parsed.rationale: All five members are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural signal is purely that they are all empty type aliases — not that they alias the same underlying type or encode the same domain concept. `Discogs.Release.Label`, `Discogs.Release.ReleaseArtist`, and `Discogs.Master.ReleaseArtist` in `Shared/Artwork/Sources/Artwork/DiscogsArtworkService.swift` are Discogs API response shape aliases, while `Release` (line 13 of `_Plant_ReleaseRepository.swift`) and `Artist` (line 13 of `_Plant_ArtistRepository.swift`) in the `Metadata` package are repository-layer aliases for entirely different domain types. The shared structure is the coincidence of being zero-field type aliases, not shared semantics. Consolidating them would conflate unrelated domain concepts across two separate packages (`Artwork` and `Metadata`).
